Circle.reason: Circle Line: Minor delays due to train cancellations.

District.reason: District Line: Severe delays between Earl's Court and Wimbledon following a late finish of engineering work. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line.

Mildmay.reason: Mildmay Line: No service between Willesden Junction and Shepherd's Bush while we fix a track fault at Shepherd's Bush. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line.

Tram.reason: LONDON TRAMS: From Thursday 6 until Sunday 30 August, no service between Arena and Elmers End at certain times. On Mondays to Fridays, no service before 0700 and after 1930, on Saturdays, no service before 0800 and after 1845, and on Sundays, no service for the whole day.

Waterloo & City.reason: Waterloo & City line: service operates 06:00 until 00:30, Monday to Friday only. There is no service on Saturdays, Sundays and on bank/public holidays.

Windrush.reason: Windrush Line: No service between Clapham Junction and Surrey Quays while we fix a track fault at Shepherd's Bush. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line.
